sourceLocation.description: Manual read-only probe (item 18) instructs running each harness from a scratch directory, but codex refuses to run in untrusted non-git directories without --skip-git-repo-check (docs/read-only.md:99-101), so the codex leg trips the git-trust check before --sandbox read-only is ever exercised.

candidates.finding: The documented codex live read-only probe runs from a non-git scratch directory where codex refuses on its git-trust check, so the step never actually exercises --sandbox read-only and produces a refusal for the wrong reason.
candidates.impact: A reviewer following the QA doc cannot confirm codex's read-only sandbox blocks writes; the one manual verification the ticket asks for is compromised for codex.
candidates.whyDeferred: Documentation-accuracy fix to a manual QA step; the shipped code and its subprocess tests are correct, and the ticket-blind classify_codex node did not adopt this as a Category-1 correctness fix.
candidates.dedupeHint: docs/qa/eh-cli.md codex read-only probe git-trust check
candidates.suggestedTitle: Run the codex live read-only QA probe in a git dir (or pass --skip-git-repo-check)
acceptanceCriteria: The codex read-only manual probe in docs/qa/eh-cli.md runs in a git-initialized directory or notes --skip-git-repo-check, so the observed refusal is produced by --sandbox read-only rather than the git-trust check.
